# Summary

The statute specifies that records of the society are retained for the period named in the schedule of this statute[[cite:obs-e3d45946fdfec3d0ca07ccdf631938fb97b0faeb "Records of the society are retained for the period named in the schedule of this statute."]]. According to the schedule, ledgers are kept for eleven calendar years and are shredded afterwards[[cite:obs-46611a66e9d66e6f0d7ae51cc3b16b73126ea454 "Ledgers: eleven calendar years, shredding afterwards."]].
